split: holdout (frozen S7 split v1, strict: holdout under every corpus name)
scorer: s7gate.py score (one scorer for every tool)

datasets.name: agentdojo
datasets.surface: tool call (single calls and call windows), with the user's task
datasets.tests: prompt-injection hijacking of a tool-using agent (workspace, travel, banking, slack): does the guard flag the calls of a compromised run? Outcome labels, alert-scored

datasets.name: agentic-redteam
datasets.surface: tool-call sequences with observations and the declared goal

datasets.name: dtap
datasets.surface: tool calls with real tool results and the user's task (benign runs only)
datasets.tests: false positives on benign, judge-confirmed agent trajectories with long tool output

datasets.name: extra-public
datasets.tests: malicious shell commands (block truth where an exact effect is proven) against successful TerminalBench runs
datasets.note: Shell Attack Evolution (the attack half) was public on Hugging Face when it was pinned (revision d201aafb); on 2026-11-13 the repo is no longer listed, so reproducing these attack rows needs that revision. TerminalBench and agent-trace (the benign half) are public.

datasets.name: injecagent
datasets.surface: tool call, with the user's task
datasets.tests: indirect prompt injection in tool output leading to direct harm or data stealing calls

datasets.name: mcphunt
datasets.surface: MCP tool calls with real tool results and the user's task
datasets.tests: executed MCP agent traces: unsafe data flows and actions next to safe controls

datasets.name: mcptox
datasets.surface: MCP tool call, with the user's task
datasets.tests: tool poisoning through MCP tool descriptions: the call a poisoned server induces (the description itself is not in the case)

datasets.name: nemotron-terminal
datasets.surface: shell commands and command windows (benign only)
datasets.tests: false positives on ordinary terminal-agent work; fixed-seed sample of 1,000 cases per side

datasets.name: prompt-agentdojo
datasets.tests: prompts that carry injected instructions against clean user prompts

datasets.name: tool-result-agentdojo
datasets.tests: tool output that carries an injection against clean tool output

datasets.name: windows-shell-public
datasets.surface: PowerShell, cmd and Git Bash commands
datasets.tests: Windows attack-emulation commands against real Windows agent shell commands

tools.name: DefenseClaw
tools.integration: agent hooks / plugins for 10 coding agents, LLM proxy, MCP and ACP routes

needs.rules: none (one Go binary, local, no model download)
needs.judge: an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (here Gemma 4 31B on Amazon Bedrock)

tools.name: Meta LlamaFirewall
tools.integration: Python library: the application calls scan() on each message

needs.promptguard: Hugging Face token with the Meta licence accepted; 1.1 GB (86M) or 0.3 GB (22M); CPU is enough
needs.alignmentcheck: an LLM API key (Together by default; Llama 4 Maverick); self-hosting Maverick needs a multi-GPU server

tools.name: Meta Llama Guard 4 12B
tools.integration: a model: serve it (vLLM) and call it per message

needs.model: Hugging Face token with the Meta licence accepted; 23 GB of weights; a GPU with 24 GB+ (here one L40S 48 GB)

tools.name: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails

surfaces.tool_call: structural (schema) only; injection YARA on arguments

tools.integration: Python library or guardrails server in front of the LLM

needs.jailbreak: gpt2-large (3.1 GB) for the heuristics, NemoGuard JailbreakDetect + Snowflake embedder (2 GB); the docs advise a separate server for production

tools.name: Invariant Guardrails
tools.integration: rules evaluated in the Invariant Gateway (LLM / MCP proxy) or with the Python analyzer; the package's default Policy class is the hosted service

tools.name: ProtectAI LLM Guard
tools.integration: Python library or API server: scan_prompt / scan_output

tools.name: IBM Granite Guardian 3.3 8B
tools.integration: a model: serve it (vLLM) and call it per message with a criteria id

needs.model: 16 GB of weights; a GPU with 24 GB+

tools.name: Qwen3Guard-Gen 8B
tools.integration: a model: serve it (vLLM / SGLang) and call it per message

needs.model: 16 GB of weights; a GPU with 24 GB+
